news-comment-moderator.title: News Comment Moderator
news-comment-moderator.summary: A pretrained-transformer pipeline that detects the frames used in a news article, then evaluates and gives feedback on comments written in response to it.

climate-narrative-analyzer.title: Climate Narrative Analyzer
climate-narrative-analyzer.summary: A dashboard that collects climate news and uses AI to show how different outlets tell the story: who is responsible, who is affected, and which wider themes appear.
